#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reviewer scoring (issue #8): planted-mistake precision/recall + status-based scorecards from the ledger.

  python scripts/ledger_score.py offline                     # default: score what is already in the ledger, no calls
  python scripts/ledger_score.py render --out <file>          # write the rendered planted fixture (for inspection)
  python scripts/ledger_score.py score-verdict --reviewer kimi --verdict <verdict.json> [--append]
  python scripts/ledger_score.py planted-live --reviewers kimi,deepseek --confirm spend   # PAID: dispatch only

Planted run: the fixture (ledger/planted/<v>/template.md, retired items as {{RETIRED:n}} placeholders) is rendered
into a throwaway local commit; the normal reviewer scripts (scripts/review_<name>.py, unchanged) review that commit;
their findings are matched against keys.json. Precision = matched findings / (matched + unmatched non-note findings);
recall = keys caught / keys planted. Outputs: ledger/scorecards.json and ledger/scorecards.md.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import ledger_lib as L  # noqa: E402

FIXTURE = L.ROOT / "ledger" / "planted" / "v1"
RETIRED_FILE = L.ROOT / "harness" / "retired.txt"


def retired_entries(path: Path = RETIRED_FILE) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    out = []
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
            label, pat, _ = [p.strip() for p in line.split(" | ", 2)]
            out.append((label, pat))
    return out


def render_fixture(fixture: Path = FIXTURE, retired=None) -> str:
    retired = retired or retired_entries()
    return re.sub(r"\{\{RETIRED:(\d+)\}\}", lambda m: retired[int(m.group(1))][0].split("(")[0].strip(),
                  (fixture / "template.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def load_keys(fixture: Path = FIXTURE) -> dict:
    return json.loads((fixture / "keys.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def key_patterns(key: dict, retired) -> list[re.Pattern]:
    pats = list(key.get("match") or [])
    if key["category"] == "retired":
        pats.append(retired[key["retired_index"]][1])
    pats.append(rf"\b(line|item|point) {key['line']}\b")
    return [re.compile(p, re.I | re.M) for p in pats]


def score(findings: list[dict], keys: dict, retired=None, cfg=None) -> dict:
    retired = retired or retired_entries()
    cfg = cfg or L.load_config()
    pats = {k["id"]: key_patterns(k, retired) for k in keys["keys"]}
    cat = {k["id"]: k["category"] for k in keys["keys"]}
    hit, tp, fp, matched = set(), 0, 0, []
    for f in findings:
        text = " ".join(str(f.get(x) or "") for x in ("claim", "note", "file"))
        ks = [kid for kid, ps in pats.items() if any(p.search(text) for p in ps)]
        if ks:
            tp += 1; hit.update(ks); matched.append({"finding": f.get("id"), "keys": ks})
        elif L.severity_rank(f.get("severity", "note"), cfg) > 0:
            fp += 1
    n = len(keys["keys"])
    by_cat = {}
    for c in sorted(set(cat.values())):
        ids = [k for k, v in cat.items() if v == c]
        by_cat[c] = {"planted": len(ids), "caught": len([k for k in ids if k in hit])}
    return {"fixture": keys["fixture"], "keys_planted": n, "keys_caught": sorted(hit),
            "recall": round(len(hit) / n, 3) if n else None,
            "precision": round(tp / (tp + fp), 3) if (tp + fp) else None,
            "matched_findings": tp, "unmatched_findings": fp, "by_category": by_cat, "matches": matched}


RECEIPT_CASES = L.ROOT / "ledger" / "planted" / "v1" / "receipts" / "cases.json"


def receipt_rubric(cases_path: Path = RECEIPT_CASES) -> dict:
    """#8 rubric, round 4: planted 'fake receipt' and 'stub receipt' cases must all be rejected, for the expected
    reason. 'permissive' cases use a verifier that accepts any signature, so the stub/digest checks must catch them
    on their own; 'none-registered' cases use a verifier that finds no attestation (as gh would for a hand-made file)."""
    import receipt as R
    verifiers = {"permissive": lambda b, ev, spec: (True, "attestation verified (planted: permissive)"),
                 "none-registered": lambda b, ev, spec: (False, "attestation not verified: no attestations found")}
    data = json.loads(Path(cases_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    rows = []
    for c in data["cases"]:
        res = R.verify_receipt(c["evidence"], c.get("claimed_digest"), attest=verifiers[c["verifier"]],
                               sources=c.get("target_sources"))
        why = "; ".join(res["reasons"])
        ok = (not res["ok"]) and c["expect_reason"].lower() in why.lower()
        rows.append({"id": c["id"], "kind": c["kind"], "rejected": not res["ok"], "reason": why[:240], "pass": ok})
    return {"fixture": data["fixture"], "cases": rows, "all_rejected": all(r["pass"] for r in rows)}


def scorecards(records: list[dict], keys: dict | None = None, cfg=None) -> dict:
    cfg = cfg or L.load_config()
    keys = keys or load_keys()
    st = L.current_status(records)
    classes = L.review_classes(records)
    cards = {}
    for r in records:
        if r["kind"] != "finding" or r.get("reviewer") not in L.REVIEWERS.values():
            continue
        c = cards.setdefault(r["reviewer"], {"findings": 0, "by_status": {s: 0 for s in L.STATUSES},
                                             "by_severity": {s: 0 for s in cfg["severity_order"]}, "planted_runs": [],
                                             "spec_review_excluded": 0, "by_class": {k: 0 for k in L.REVIEW_CLASSES}})
        c.setdefault("spec_review_excluded", 0); c.setdefault("by_class", {k: 0 for k in L.REVIEW_CLASSES})
        if r["source"]["type"] == "planted":
            continue
        cls = classes.get(r["id"], "legacy")
        c["by_class"][cls] += 1
        if cls == "spec-review":            # round 4: spec reviews never count toward scorecards
            c["spec_review_excluded"] += 1
            continue
        c["findings"] += 1
        c["by_status"].setdefault(st.get(r["id"], "open"), 0)
        c["by_status"][st.get(r["id"], "open")] += 1   # deferred / superseded are their own buckets, never "open"
        c["by_severity"][r["severity"]] += 1
    for c in cards.values():
        # deferred and superseded are decided but not scored: they are in neither the numerator nor the denominator
        good, bad = c["by_status"]["accepted"] + c["by_status"]["fixed"], c["by_status"]["rejected"]
        c["acceptance_rate"] = round(good / (good + bad), 3) if (good + bad) else None
    runs = {}
    for r in records:
        if r["kind"] == "finding" and r["source"]["type"] == "planted" and classes.get(r["id"]) != "spec-review":
            runs.setdefault((r["reviewer"], r["source"].get("run_id")), []).append(r)
    for (rev, run), fs in sorted(runs.items(), key=lambda kv: str(kv[0])):
        s = score(fs, keys, cfg=cfg)
        cards.setdefault(rev, {"findings": 0, "by_status": {}, "by_severity": {}, "planted_runs": [], "acceptance_rate": None})
        cards[rev]["planted_runs"].append({"run": run, "event_utc": fs[0].get("event_utc"), **{k: s[k] for k in

    return {"generated_utc": L.ledger_as_of(records), "fixture": keys["fixture"], "reviewers": cards,
            "receipt_rubric": receipt_rubric()}


def render_md(sc: dict) -> str:
    L_ = ["# Reviewer scorecards", "", f"Ledger as of {sc['generated_utc']}, from `ledger/findings.jsonl` (issue #8).", "",
          "Acceptance = (accepted + fixed) / (accepted + fixed + rejected), from closed ledger issues and CI-ingested staged "
          "decisions; deferred and superseded are not open and not scored. Planted = the latest "
          f"planted-mistake run against `{sc['fixture']}` (recall = seeded mistakes caught / planted).", "",
          "| Reviewer | findings | open | accepted | fixed | rejected | deferred | superseded | acceptance | planted recall | planted precision | planted runs |",
          "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for rev in ("Claude", "Grok", "Kimi", "DeepSeek"):
        c = sc["reviewers"].get(rev)
        if not c:
            L_.append(f"| {rev} | 0 | | | | | | | n/a | not run | not run | 0 |"); continue
        b, last = c.get("by_status", {}), (c["planted_runs"][-1] if c["planted_runs"] else None)
        fmt = lambda v: "n/a" if v is None else f"{v:.0%}"
        L_.append(f"| {rev} | {c['findings']} | {b.get('open', 0)} | {b.get('accepted', 0)} | {b.get('fixed', 0)} | "
                  f"{b.get('rejected', 0)} | {b.get('deferred', 0)} | {b.get('superseded', 0)} | {fmt(c.get('acceptance_rate'))} | "
                  f"{fmt(last['recall']) if last else 'not run'} | {fmt(last['precision']) if last else 'not run'} | "
                  f"{len(c['planted_runs'])} |")
    L_ += ["", "Spec-review findings (no execution receipt) are excluded from every number above; legacy = before the "
           "receipt gate. Excluded per reviewer: " + ", ".join(f"{rev} {sc['reviewers'].get(rev, {}).get('spec_review_excluded', 0)}"
                                                         for rev in ("Claude", "Grok", "Kimi", "DeepSeek")) + "."]
    rr = sc.get("receipt_rubric")
    if rr:
        L_ += ["", f"## Planted receipt cases (`{rr['fixture']}`): {'all rejected' if rr['all_rejected'] else 'NOT ALL REJECTED'}", "",
               "| case | kind | rejected | reason |", "|---|---|---|---|"]
        for c in rr["cases"]:
            L_.append(f"| {c['id']} | {c['kind']} | {'yes' if c['rejected'] else 'NO'} | {c['reason'][:120]} |")
    return "\n".join(L_) + "\n"


def write_scorecards(records, out_dir: Path) -> dict:
    sc = scorecards(records)
    (out_dir / "scorecards.json").write_text(json.dumps(sc, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (out_dir / "scorecards.md").write_text(render_md(sc), encoding="utf-8")
    return sc


def planted_findings_from_verdict(v: dict, run_id: str, cfg) -> list[dict]:
    return [r for r in L.parse_verdict_json(v, cfg, "planted-v1", run_id, source_type="planted", salt=run_id)
            if r["kind"] in ("finding", "cost")]


def planted_live(reviewers: list[str], depth: str, run_id: str, cfg) -> list[dict]:
    """PAID. Render fixture into a throwaway commit in a temp clone and run the normal reviewer scripts on it."""
    recs = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        wt = Path(td) / "wt"
        subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "-q", "--no-hardlinks", str(L.ROOT), str(wt)], check=True)
        dest = wt / load_keys()["rendered_path"]
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest.write_text(render_fixture(), encoding="utf-8")
        g = lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(wt), *a], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
        g("add", "-A"); g("-c", "user.name=ledger", "-c", "user.email=ledger@localhost", "commit", "-qm", "planted fixture (local only)")
        for rv in reviewers:
            out = Path(td) / f"out-{rv}"
            subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(wt / "scripts" / f"review_{rv}.py"), "--depth", depth, "--base", "HEAD~1",
                            "--head", "HEAD", "--domains", "all", "--out", str(out),
                            "--intent", "Lock-shell summary for the thermal harness."], cwd=wt, check=False)
            vf = out / "verdict.json"
            if vf.is_file():
                recs += planted_findings_from_verdict(json.loads(vf.read_text()), f"{run_id}-{rv}", cfg)
    return recs


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    sp = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd")
    sp.add_parser("offline")
    p = sp.add_parser("render"); p.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    p = sp.add_parser("score-verdict"); p.add_argument("--verdict", required=True); p.add_argument("--run-id", default="manual")
    p.add_argument("--append", action="store_true")
    p = sp.add_parser("planted-live"); p.add_argument("--reviewers", default="kimi,deepseek")
    p.add_argument("--depth", default="shallow"); p.add_argument("--confirm", default=""); p.add_argument("--run-id", default="local")
    p.add_argument("--records-out", default=None, help="also write the new records here (so a push retry never re-calls models)")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    cfg = L.load_config()
    path = L.ROOT / cfg["ledger_path"]
    cmd = a.cmd or "offline"
    if cmd == "render":
        Path(a.out).write_text(render_fixture(), encoding="utf-8"); print(a.out); return
    if cmd == "score-verdict":
        recs = planted_findings_from_verdict(json.loads(Path(a.verdict).read_text()), a.run_id, cfg)
        print(json.dumps(score([r for r in recs if r["kind"] == "finding"], load_keys(), cfg=cfg), indent=2))
        if a.append:
            L.append_records(path, recs)
    elif cmd == "planted-live":
        if a.confirm != "spend":
            sys.exit("planted-live makes PAID model calls. Re-run with --confirm spend (dispatch only).")
        revs = [r.strip().lower() for r in a.reviewers.split(",") if r.strip()]
        bad = [r for r in revs if r not in L.REVIEWERS]
        if bad:
            sys.exit(f"unknown reviewer(s): {bad}")
        recs = planted_live(revs, a.depth, a.run_id, cfg)
        L.append_records(path, recs)
        if a.records_out:
            Path(a.records_out).write_text("".join(json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in recs), encoding="utf-8")
        print(json.dumps({k: score([r for r in recs if r["kind"] == "finding" and r["source"]["run_id"].endswith(k)],
                                   load_keys(), cfg=cfg)["recall"] for k in revs}))
    sc = write_scorecards(L.read_ledger(path), path.parent)
    print(render_md(sc))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Run a review round as a fixed four-step sequence and land every reply in the review tree (stdlib only).
3	
4	  # Full round (default --stage all): fire -> land (gate 1) -> cross-review (gate 2) -> close
5	  python scripts/launch_round.py --round-dir reviews/2026-10-19_round6 \
6	
7	
8	  # Single stages (recovery / re-runs); each still enforces the gate before it
9	  python scripts/launch_round.py --stage primary  --round-dir R --prompt P --run-dir /tmp/rN-run
10	  python scripts/launch_round.py --stage teamwork --round-dir R --run-dir /tmp/rN-teamwork
11	  python scripts/launch_round.py --stage close    --round-dir R --run-dir /tmp/rN-run   # check-only
12	
13	Sequence (cannot be skipped):
14	  (a) fire   primary: shared brief -> review_{kimi,deepseek,claude,grok}.py --land-dir --run-id.
15	  (b) land   Gate 1 (primary COMPLETE): kimi.md, deepseek.md, claude.md, grok.md all present AND stamped with the
16	             current primary run_id (none older than the run start).
17	  (c) cross-review  teamwork: refuses to start unless gate 1 passes; each model gets the other three replies
18	             (current-run versions, with their run_id) and scores them; lands {model}_teamwork.md. Gate 2 (teamwork
19	             COMPLETE): all four *_teamwork.md present and stamped with the current teamwork run_id.
20	
21	  (d) close  the round closes only when gate 1 and gate 2 both pass AND the teamwork run scored the current primary
22	             run (a primary re-fire after cross-review re-opens the round). Close is recorded in <round-dir>/run.json.
23	
24	Runs are recorded in <round-dir>/run.json (land_review_reply.start_run). Starting a primary run clears the teamwork
25	run and any close record, so a re-fire can never be closed against cross-reviews of the old replies.
26	
27	--land-only re-lands from an existing <run-dir> without any API call (recovery). Replies must still belong to the
28	current run for that stage (stale replies are refused). With --stage teamwork, lands as {model}_teamwork.md.
29	Exit codes: 0 stage/round COMPLETE (or CLOSED for close/all), 1 NOT COMPLETE / gate failed.
30	
31	round_config.json rounds (round 8 on). Legacy folders (no round_config.json) keep every behaviour above unchanged.
32	  - roster = config "models" (claude_code included -> review_claude_code.py); depth = param model_depth;
33	    --tools passed to every runner when config "tools" is true; DEEPSEEK_MODEL = param deepseek_round_model for the
34	    primary and cross-review stages (fix d), and close checks both DeepSeek headers carry that model.
35	  - fix (a): --round N is required and must match the config "round" and the "Round: N" line of <round-dir>/mission.md;
36	    the mission text for cross-review comes from mission.md (the "Round:" line is stripped). Mismatch -> exit 2.
37	  - preflight: every named parameter set and nothing left in the config "proposed" map, or the launcher will not fire.
38	  - brief at fire time: the exact heading "# Round N kickoff: DRAFT (not approved)" is removed from the text sent
39	    (the brief file is never edited; removal logged in <run-dir>/brief_prep.json); any remaining FIRE_REFUSE_PATTERNS
40	    line stops the fire.
41	  - cross-review brief = CONFIG_TEAMWORK_BRIEF (roster from config, mission from mission.md, full peer replies per
42	    D12); --teamwork-summary sends only each peer's "## Conclusions" block instead (refuses if one is missing).
43	
44	    built by scripts/cc_export.py at <CC_EXPORT_ROOT or /tmp/ensemble_cc_export>/<run-id>/ and grepped for the leak
45	    patterns; any hit refuses the fire before a run is recorded, listing the hits. Every runner gets CC_EXPORT_DIR
46	    (Claude Code's own replies and every routed request run there). --dry-run builds and checks it in a temporary
47	    folder and reports, then removes that temporary folder.
48	  - stage labels: "Replies landed" / "Cross-review complete" (the brief's "gate 1" is the automated check in
49	    scripts/gate1.py, run with the hand-off after --stage all, or alone with --stage handoff).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run a review round as a fixed four-step sequence and land every reply in the review tree (stdlib only).

  # Full round (default --stage all): fire -> land (gate 1) -> cross-review (gate 2) -> close
  python scripts/launch_round.py --round-dir reviews/2026-10-19_round6 \


  # Single stages (recovery / re-runs); each still enforces the gate before it
  python scripts/launch_round.py --stage primary  --round-dir R --prompt P --run-dir /tmp/rN-run
  python scripts/launch_round.py --stage teamwork --round-dir R --run-dir /tmp/rN-teamwork
  python scripts/launch_round.py --stage close    --round-dir R --run-dir /tmp/rN-run   # check-only

Sequence (cannot be skipped):
  (a) fire   primary: shared brief -> review_{kimi,deepseek,claude,grok}.py --land-dir --run-id.
  (b) land   Gate 1 (primary COMPLETE): kimi.md, deepseek.md, claude.md, grok.md all present AND stamped with the
             current primary run_id (none older than the run start).
  (c) cross-review  teamwork: refuses to start unless gate 1 passes; each model gets the other three replies
             (current-run versions, with their run_id) and scores them; lands {model}_teamwork.md. Gate 2 (teamwork
             COMPLETE): all four *_teamwork.md present and stamped with the current teamwork run_id.

  (d) close  the round closes only when gate 1 and gate 2 both pass AND the teamwork run scored the current primary
             run (a primary re-fire after cross-review re-opens the round). Close is recorded in <round-dir>/run.json.

Runs are recorded in <round-dir>/run.json (land_review_reply.start_run). Starting a primary run clears the teamwork
run and any close record, so a re-fire can never be closed against cross-reviews of the old replies.

--land-only re-lands from an existing <run-dir> without any API call (recovery). Replies must still belong to the
current run for that stage (stale replies are refused). With --stage teamwork, lands as {model}_teamwork.md.
Exit codes: 0 stage/round COMPLETE (or CLOSED for close/all), 1 NOT COMPLETE / gate failed.

round_config.json rounds (round 8 on). Legacy folders (no round_config.json) keep every behaviour above unchanged.
  - roster = config "models" (claude_code included -> review_claude_code.py); depth = param model_depth;
    --tools passed to every runner when config "tools" is true; DEEPSEEK_MODEL = param deepseek_round_model for the
    primary and cross-review stages (fix d), and close checks both DeepSeek headers carry that model.
  - fix (a): --round N is required and must match the config "round" and the "Round: N" line of <round-dir>/mission.md;
    the mission text for cross-review comes from mission.md (the "Round:" line is stripped). Mismatch -> exit 2.
  - preflight: every named parameter set and nothing left in the config "proposed" map, or the launcher will not fire.
  - brief at fire time: the exact heading "# Round N kickoff: DRAFT (not approved)" is removed from the text sent
    (the brief file is never edited; removal logged in <run-dir>/brief_prep.json); any remaining FIRE_REFUSE_PATTERNS
    line stops the fire.
  - cross-review brief = CONFIG_TEAMWORK_BRIEF (roster from config, mission from mission.md, full peer replies per
    D12); --teamwork-summary sends only each peer's "## Conclusions" block instead (refuses if one is missing).

    built by scripts/cc_export.py at <CC_EXPORT_ROOT or /tmp/ensemble_cc_export>/<run-id>/ and grepped for the leak
    patterns; any hit refuses the fire before a run is recorded, listing the hits. Every runner gets CC_EXPORT_DIR
    (Claude Code's own replies and every routed request run there). --dry-run builds and checks it in a temporary
    folder and reports, then removes that temporary folder.
  - stage labels: "Replies landed" / "Cross-review complete" (the brief's "gate 1" is the automated check in
    scripts/gate1.py, run with the hand-off after --stage all, or alone with --stage handoff).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import land_review_reply as lr  # noqa: E402

HEADER_RE = re.compile(r"\A<!-- landed: .*?-->\n+", re.S)
NAMES = {"kimi": "Kimi", "deepseek": "DeepSeek", "claude": "Claude", "grok": "Grok"}
CONFIG_NAMES = {**NAMES, "claude_code": "Claude Code"}       # round_config.json rounds only
MISSION_FILE = "mission.md"
ROUND_LINE_RE = re.compile(r"^Round:\s*(\d+)\s*$", re.M)
DRAFT_HEADING_RE = r"^# Round {n} kickoff: DRAFT \(not approved\)[ \t]*\n?"
# Operator-only text that must never reach a model. A brief line matching any of these stops the fire.
FIRE_REFUSE_PATTERNS = (r"\bDRAFT\b", r"not approved", r"^LOCKED\b", r"\bArchive/", r"\bPROPOSED\b",
                        r"\[FILL IN\]", r"_rev\d+\b")
CONFIG_TEAMWORK_BRIEF = """# Cross-review

You are **{name}**, one of the Ensemble: {roster}.

## Mission
{mission}

## Freshness (verified by the launcher)
All replies below are from this round.

## Your own primary reply (context; do not re-argue from scratch)
{own}

## Peer replies to score
{peers}
"""

# (land_review_reply.check_detail) and records each peer's run id in <run-dir>/<model>/freshness.json and run.json.



# Today this brief still injects full peer bodies via build_teamwork_prompt → _body(...) so


TEAMWORK_BRIEF = """# Round cross-review (teamwork)

You are **{name}** on the Stratified Sphere four-model team (Kimi, DeepSeek, Claude, Grok).

## Mission (score every peer against this — pass/fail)

- **No invented thresholds** (do not invent escalate cutoffs, amplitudes, frequencies, or pressures)

- Pass = peer stays inside that mission; Fail = peer invents numbers, runs/proposes a sweep this round, or mis-assigns the sweep to the wrong round without correcting it

## Freshness (verified by the launcher)
All four replies below are from primary run `{primary_run_id}` (each file stamped with that run_id; none predates the run start).
{freshness}
Score the text as given. Do not assume any reply is from an earlier run unless its stamp says so.

## Your own primary reply (context — do not re-argue from scratch)
{own}

## Peer replies to score
{peers}

## Required deliverable
1. For **each** peer above: **PASS** or **FAIL** against the mission, with a one-line reason.
2. Brief critique of each peer's arguments (what holds, what does not).
3. Explicit statement: do you **agree with the round-8 consensus** (sweep deferred to round 8)? Yes/No + one sentence.
4. If any peer assigns the sweep to the wrong round, say whether that alone is a FAIL or a soft flag.

Stay inside this cross-review. Do not run a sweep. Do not invent thresholds. Keep the reply concise.
"""


def _body(path: Path) -> str:
    return HEADER_RE.sub("", path.read_text()).strip()


def _gate(round_dir: Path, models, suffix: str, label: str) -> bool:
    bad = lr.check_detail(round_dir, models, suffix=suffix)
    names = f"{{m}}{suffix}.md"
    if bad:
        print(f"{label} NOT COMPLETE in {round_dir}: "
              + "; ".join(f"{names.format(m=m)} ({why})" for m, why in bad.items()), file=sys.stderr)
        return False
    run = lr.current_run(round_dir, "teamwork" if suffix else "primary")
    print(f"{label} COMPLETE: {', '.join(names.format(m=m) for m in models)} in {round_dir}"
          + (f" (run {run['run_id']})" if run else ""))
    return True


def _conclusions(path: Path) -> str:
    """The '## Conclusions' block of a reply (to the next '## ' heading). ValueError if there is none."""
    m = re.search(r"^## Conclusions[^\n]*\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", _body(path), re.S | re.M)
    if not m or not m.group(1).strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{path.name}: no '## Conclusions' block; --teamwork-summary refuses")
    return m.group(1).strip()


def read_mission(round_dir: Path, round_no) -> str:
    """fix (a): mission text from <round-dir>/mission.md; its 'Round: N' line must match round_no (stripped)."""
    f = Path(round_dir) / MISSION_FILE
    if not f.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{f} missing: the mission comes from the round folder, not the launcher")
    text = f.read_text()
    m = ROUND_LINE_RE.search(text)
    if not m or int(m.group(1)) != int(round_no):
        raise ValueError(f"round mismatch: {f} says {m.group(1) if m else 'no Round: line'}, expected {round_no}")
    return ROUND_LINE_RE.sub("", text, count=1).strip()


def check_round(round_dir: Path, cfg, round_no) -> None:
    """fix (a): --round must match the config and mission.md. ValueError on mismatch."""
    if round_no is None:
        raise ValueError("--round N is required for a round_config.json round")
    if int(cfg.data.get("round") or -1) != int(round_no):
        raise ValueError(f"round mismatch: round_config.json says {cfg.data.get('round')}, --round {round_no}")
    read_mission(round_dir, round_no)


def preflight(cfg) -> list[str]:
    """Reasons the launcher must not fire this config round (empty = OK)."""
    out = [f"UNSET {k}" for k in cfg.unset()]
    out += [f"PROPOSED {k} (awaiting Danny)" for k in cfg.proposed]
    if not cfg.unset():
        import round_budget as rb
        try:
            out += [f"NO PRICE {m} on file and not in unpriced_allowed (round_budget_usd could not count its "
                    f"replies)" for m in rb.unpriced_models(cfg)]
        except ValueError as e:
            out.append(f"BAD round_config: {e}")
    return out


def prepare_brief(text: str, round_no) -> tuple[str, dict]:
    """Remove the exact draft heading for this round (fire time only). ValueError if operator-only text remains."""
    pat = re.compile(DRAFT_HEADING_RE.format(n=int(round_no)), re.M)
    removed = [m.group(0).rstrip("\n") for m in pat.finditer(text)]
    out = pat.sub("", text)
    hits = []
    for i, line in enumerate(out.splitlines(), 1):
        for rx in FIRE_REFUSE_PATTERNS:
            if re.search(rx, line):
                hits.append({"line": i, "pattern": rx, "text": line[:160]})
                break
    info = {"removed": removed, "refused_lines": hits}
    if hits:
        raise ValueError("brief still carries operator-only text; not firing: "
                         + "; ".join(f"line {h['line']} matches {h['pattern']}" for h in hits[:5]))
    return out, info


def build_teamwork_prompt(round_dir: Path, model: str, summary: bool = False) -> str:
    """Per-model cross-review brief. Refuses (FileNotFoundError / StaleReplyError) unless gate 1 passes."""
    round_dir = Path(round_dir)
    if (round_dir / "round_config.json").is_file():
        return _config_teamwork_prompt(round_dir, model, summary)
    bad = lr.check_detail(round_dir)
    missing = {m: w for m, w in bad.items() if w == "missing"}
    if missing:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"missing primary reply {round_dir / (next(iter(missing)) + '.md')}")
    if bad:
        raise lr.StaleReplyError("primary gate not passed; cross-review would score stale/empty replies: "
                                 + "; ".join(f"{m}.md ({w})" for m, w in bad.items()))
    run = lr.current_run(round_dir, "primary") or {}
    fresh, peer_bits = [], []
    for m in lr.MODELS:
        meta = lr.parse_header((round_dir / f"{m}.md").read_text())
        fresh.append(f"- `{m}.md`: run_id `{meta.get('run_id', 'unstamped')}` · generated "
                     f"`{meta.get('generated_utc', '?')}` · model `{meta.get('model', '?')}`")
        if m != model:
            body = _conclusions(round_dir / f"{m}.md") if summary else _body(round_dir / f"{m}.md")
            peer_bits.append(f"### {NAMES[m]} (`{m}.md`)\n\n{body}")
    return TEAMWORK_BRIEF.format(name=NAMES[model], own=_body(round_dir / f"{model}.md"),
                                 peers="\n\n".join(peer_bits), primary_run_id=run.get("run_id", "legacy (no run.json)"),
                                 freshness="\n".join(fresh))


def _config_teamwork_prompt(round_dir: Path, model: str, summary: bool) -> str:
    import round_config as rc
    cfg = rc.require_config(round_dir)
    models = list(cfg.models)
    bad = lr.check_detail(round_dir, models)
    if any(w == "missing" for w in bad.values()):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"missing primary reply {round_dir / (next(m for m, w in bad.items() if w == 'missing') + '.md')}")
    if bad:
        raise lr.StaleReplyError("primary replies not all landed and current: "
                                 + "; ".join(f"{m}.md ({w})" for m, w in bad.items()))
    peers = []
    for m in models:
        if m == model:
            continue
        body = _conclusions(round_dir / f"{m}.md") if summary else _body(round_dir / f"{m}.md")
        peers.append(f"### {CONFIG_NAMES[m]}\n\n{body}")
    return CONFIG_TEAMWORK_BRIEF.format(
        name=CONFIG_NAMES[model], roster=", ".join(CONFIG_NAMES[m] for m in models),
        mission=read_mission(round_dir, cfg.data.get("round")),
        own=_body(round_dir / f"{model}.md"), peers="\n\n".join(peers))


def teamwork_freshness(round_dir: Path, model: str) -> dict:
    """What the launcher verified for one cross-review prompt (log only; never sent to a model)."""
    import round_config as rc
    cfg = rc.require_config(round_dir)
    run = lr.current_run(round_dir, "primary") or {}
    peers = {m: lr.parse_header((Path(round_dir) / f"{m}.md").read_text()).get("run_id", "unstamped")
             for m in cfg.models if m != model}
    return {"model": model, "primary_run_id": run.get("run_id"), "peers": peers,
            "all_current": all(v == run.get("run_id") for v in peers.values())}


def new_run_id(stage: str) -> str:
    """Same format as land_review_reply.start_run, made before the run is recorded (the export is named by it)."""
    import secrets
    return f"{stage}-{lr.now_utc().replace('-', '').replace(':', '')}-{secrets.token_hex(3)}"


def build_cc_export(round_dir: Path, run_id: str, dest_root=None) -> tuple[dict, list[str]]:
    """Build and check Claude Code's clean copy. Returns (manifest, refusal lines); refusal lines empty = OK."""
    import cc_export as cx
    old = os.environ.get("CC_EXPORT_ROOT")
    if dest_root is not None:
        os.environ["CC_EXPORT_ROOT"] = str(dest_root)
    try:
        src = os.environ.get("CC_EXPORT_SOURCE")              # tests only (offline e2e); the leak check still runs
        man = cx.build(run_id, root=Path(src) if src else cx.ROOT, round_dir=round_dir)
    except (ValueError, FileExistsError) as e:
        return {}, [f"Claude Code clean copy not built: {e}"]
    finally:
        if dest_root is not None:
            if old is None:
                os.environ.pop("CC_EXPORT_ROOT", None)
            else:
                os.environ["CC_EXPORT_ROOT"] = old
    return man, [f"{h['file']}:{h['line']} [{h['pattern']}] {h['text']}" for h in man["hits"]]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Gate 1 for a round_config.json round (stdlib only; no network, no model calls in this round).

Gate 1 is the automated check the brief describes: recommendations are verified against predictions recorded before
the round fired. Predictions are deferred for round 8, so with no <round-dir>/predictions.jsonl gate 1 still runs,
does the mechanical checks below, and reports "no predictions this round" (it does not fail).

Per landed reply (primary {model}.md and cross-review {model}_teamwork.md), current runs only:
  hold  truncated          check_detail says TRUNCATED (finish was a truncation/error stop, or no finish recorded)
  hold  stale_run          check_detail says STALE
  hold  misidentified      land() refused the reply (landing_refusals.jsonl), so nothing landed for it
  hold  turn_cap_reached   the reply's tool loop hit tool_max_turns / tool_max_calls (flow_log cap_event)
  hold  budget_stop        one of the reply's requests ended in budget_stop, or the runner stopped before a model
                           call because round_budget_usd (the round total) was reached (flow_log budget_event;
                           nothing landed for that reply)
  hold  gate1_refused      predictions.jsonl changed after the primary run fired (sha256 differs from run.json)
  hold  gate1_unverifiable predictions are present but the verification step is not built (round 8: deferred)
  flag  first_step_failure the reply's first request was not a read of a context_first_docs document (D10: flag only,
                           never holds)
The answered_by trace (D9: Claude Code both answers questions and is one of the reviewers; the conflict is accepted
and made visible) counts, per model, the answers that came from Claude Code and the decisions it delivered.

Writes <round-dir>/gate1/{summary.md,items.jsonl,gaps.jsonl}; an existing file is moved to gate1/archive/ as _revN
first (never overwritten, never deleted).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import land_review_reply as lr  # noqa: E402
import round_config as rc  # noqa: E402

PREDICTIONS = "predictions.jsonl"
NO_PREDICTIONS = "no predictions this round"
REQUEST_TOOLS = ("read_doc", "request_info", "ask_claude_code")
HOLD_ORDER = ("misidentified", "stale_run", "truncated", "gate1_refused", "gate1_unverifiable", "budget_stop",
              "turn_cap_reached")


def read_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    if not Path(path).is_file():
        return []
    out = []
    for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if line:
            try:
                out.append(json.loads(line))
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                out.append({"_unreadable": line[:200]})
    return out


def write_new(path: Path, text: str) -> Path:
    """Write text to path; an existing different file is first moved to <dir>/archive/<stem>_revN<suffix>."""
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if path.is_file():
        if path.read_text() == text:
            return path
        arch = path.parent / "archive"
        arch.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        n = 1
        while (arch / f"{path.stem}_rev{n}{path.suffix}").exists():
            n += 1
        os.replace(path, arch / f"{path.stem}_rev{n}{path.suffix}")
    tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(text)
    os.replace(tmp, path)
    return path


def predictions_sha(round_dir) -> str | None:
    f = Path(round_dir) / PREDICTIONS
    return hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if f.is_file() else None


def predictions_status(round_dir) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
    """(status, hold reason for every item or None)."""
    sha = predictions_sha(round_dir)
    locked = (lr.current_run(round_dir, "primary") or {}).get("predictions_sha256")
    if sha is None and not locked:
        return NO_PREDICTIONS, None
    if sha is None:
        return "predictions.jsonl was locked at fire but is now missing", "gate1_refused"
    if sha != locked:
        return "predictions.jsonl differs from the copy locked when the primary run fired", "gate1_refused"
    return "predictions present and locked; verification step not built this round", "gate1_unverifiable"


def _run_ids(round_dir) -> dict:
    runs = lr.load_runs(round_dir)
    return {st: (runs.get(st) or {}).get("run_id") for st in lr.STAGES}


def context_first(lines: list[dict], docs_ok, doc_paths) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """First request of one reply: pass if it reads one of the context_first_docs."""
    for r in lines:
        if r.get("tool") in REQUEST_TOOLS:
            name = (r.get("args") or {}).get("name")
            if r["tool"] == "read_doc" and name in docs_ok:
                return True, f"read_doc {name}"
            return False, f"first request was {r['tool']} {json.dumps(r.get('args') or {})[:120]}"
        if r.get("tool") == "native_read":
            inp = r.get("input") or {}
            path = str(inp.get("file_path") or inp.get("path") or inp.get("pattern") or "")
            if any(path.endswith(p) for p in doc_paths):
                return True, f"native read {path}"
            return False, f"first native read was {r.get('native_tool')} {path[:120]}"
    return False, "no requests made"


def run(round_dir) -> dict:
    round_dir = Path(round_dir)
    cfg = rc.require_config(round_dir)
    models = list(cfg.models)
    docs_ok = list(cfg.param("context_first_docs"))
    doc_paths = [str(cfg.docs[d]) for d in docs_ok if d in cfg.docs]
    rids = _run_ids(round_dir)
    flow = read_jsonl(round_dir / "flow_log.jsonl")
    refusals = read_jsonl(round_dir / lr.REFUSALS_FILE)
    pstatus, phold = predictions_status(round_dir)
    items, gaps, trace = [], [], {}
    for stage, suffix in (("primary", ""), ("teamwork", "_teamwork")):
        rid = rids.get(stage)
        if not rid:
            gaps.append({"stage": stage, "gap": f"no {stage} run recorded in run.json"})
            continue
        bad = lr.check_detail(round_dir, models, suffix=suffix)
        for m in models:
            item_id = f"{m}{suffix}"
            mine = [r for r in flow if r.get("asked_by") == m and r.get("stage") == stage and r.get("run_id") == rid]
            reasons, flags, notes = [], [], []
            why = bad.get(m)
            refused = [r for r in refusals if r.get("stem") == item_id and r.get("run_id") in (rid, None)]
            stopped = [r for r in mine if r.get("tool") == "budget_event"]
            if why == "missing":
                if refused:
                    reasons.append("misidentified")
                    notes.append(refused[-1].get("reason"))
                elif stopped:
                    reasons.append("budget_stop")
                    notes.append(stopped[-1].get("note"))
                else:
                    gaps.append({"stage": stage, "item_id": item_id, "gap": "no reply landed"})
                    continue
            elif why and why.startswith("STALE"):
                reasons.append("stale_run"); notes.append(why)
            elif why and why.startswith("TRUNCATED"):
                reasons.append("truncated"); notes.append(why)
            elif why:
                gaps.append({"stage": stage, "item_id": item_id, "gap": why})
                continue
            if phold:
                reasons.append(phold); notes.append(pstatus)
            caps = sorted({r.get("event") for r in mine if r.get("tool") == "cap_event"})
            if caps:
                reasons.append("turn_cap_reached"); notes.append(", ".join(caps))
            if any(r.get("final_status") == "budget_stop" for r in mine) and "budget_stop" not in reasons:
                reasons.append("budget_stop")
            ok, how = context_first(mine, docs_ok, doc_paths)
            if not ok:
                flags.append("first_step_failure")
            notes.append(f"context first: {how}")
            reasons = [h for h in HOLD_ORDER if h in reasons]
            items.append({"item_id": item_id, "model": m, "stage": stage, "run_id": rid,
                          "decision": "hold" if reasons else "deliver", "reasons": reasons, "flags": flags,
                          "notes": notes, "file": f"{item_id}.md", "landed": why != "missing"})
    for m in models:
        mine = [r for r in flow if r.get("asked_by") == m and r.get("tool") in REQUEST_TOOLS]
        trace[m] = {"requests": len(mine),
                    "answered_by_claude_code": sum(1 for r in mine if r.get("answered_by") == "claude_code"),
                    "decisions_delivered": sum(int(r.get("decisions_delivered") or 0) for r in mine)}
    held = [i for i in items if i["decision"] == "hold"]
    line = (f"{pstatus}; {len(items) - len(held)} deliver, {len(held)} hold, "
            f"{sum(1 for i in items if i['flags'])} flagged, {len(gaps)} gap(s)")
    res = {"ran": True, "predictions": pstatus, "items": items, "gaps": gaps, "answered_by_trace": trace,
           "summary_line": line, "run_ids": rids}
    _write(round_dir, res)
    return res


def _write(round_dir: Path, res: dict) -> None:
    g = round_dir / "gate1"
    md = ["# Gate 1", "", f"Predictions: **{res['predictions']}**", "", f"Result: {res['summary_line']}", "",
          "| item | decision | hold reasons | flags | notes |", "|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for i in res["items"]:
        md.append(f"| {i['item_id']} | {i['decision']} | {', '.join(i['reasons']) or '-'} | "
                  f"{', '.join(i['flags']) or '-'} | {'; '.join(n for n in i['notes'] if n)} |")
    md += ["", "## answered_by trace (D9: conflict accepted, shown here)", "",
           "| model | requests | answered by Claude Code | decisions delivered |", "|---|---|---|---|"]
    for m, t in res["answered_by_trace"].items():
        md.append(f"| {m} | {t['requests']} | {t['answered_by_claude_code']} | {t['decisions_delivered']} |")
    if res["gaps"]:
        md += ["", "## Gaps", ""] + [f"- {json.dumps(x)}" for x in res["gaps"]]
    write_new(g / "summary.md", "\n".join(md) + "\n")
    write_new(g / "items.jsonl", "".join(json.dumps(i) + "\n" for i in res["items"]))
    write_new(g / "gaps.jsonl", "".join(json.dumps(x) + "\n" for x in res["gaps"]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import argparse
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Gate 1 (round_config.json rounds)")
    ap.add_argument("--round-dir", required=True)
    r = run(ap.parse_args().round_dir)
    print(r["summary_line"])

        return 0 if _gate(round_dir, models, suffix, f"{stage} (land-only)") else 1

    if a.stage in ("all", "primary"):
        if not a.prompt:
            print("error: --prompt is required for --stage all/primary (unless --land-only)", file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        if cfg is not None:
            try:                                                 # refuse before a run is recorded
                prepare_brief(Path(a.prompt).read_text(), cfg.data.get("round"))
            except ValueError as e:
                print(f"NOT FIRED: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
                return 2
        extra = {}
        if cfg is not None:                                      # predictions (if any) locked at fire for gate 1
            import gate1
            sha = gate1.predictions_sha(round_dir)
            extra = {"predictions_sha256": sha} if sha else {}
        cc = None
        if cfg is not None:                                      # clean copy for Claude Code, refused before a run
            got = _cc_export_or_refuse(round_dir, "primary")
            if got is None:
                return 2
            extra["run_id"], cc = got
            extra["cc_export"] = cc
        rid = lr.start_run(round_dir, "primary", **extra)["run_id"]
        print(f"(a) fire: primary run {rid}")
        _fire("primary", a, round_dir, run, models, rid, *((cfg,) if cfg is not None else ()), **({"cc_export": cc} if cfg is not None else {}))
        if not _gate(round_dir, models, "", L["g1"]):
            return 1

    if not _gate(round_dir, models, "", L["pre"]):
        print(L["pre_fail"], file=sys.stderr)

    prim = lr.current_run(round_dir, "primary")
    trun = Path(a.teamwork_run_dir) if a.teamwork_run_dir else (

    if a.stage == "teamwork":

    return 0 if close_round(round_dir, models) else 1

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Hand-off after gate 1 for a round_config.json round (stdlib only). Files only: nothing is sent anywhere.

  to_danny/packet.md      delivered items (file names), flags, predictions line, held summary
  to_danny/gaps.jsonl     gate 1 gaps
  to_danny/questions.jsonl  the router's L4 queue (written by harness_router); hand-off never writes to it. Items held

                          "Held folder only, no queue note")
  to_danny/flow_report.md written by flow_report.py (S11)
  held/<item>.json        one file per held item
  handoff_log.jsonl       append-only: {ts, run_id, item_id, model, decision, reason, rule}
Existing packet/gaps/held files are moved to archive/ as _revN before a new version is written (gate1.write_new).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import gate1  # noqa: E402
import harness_store as hs  # noqa: E402

RULES = {
    "deliver": "gate 1 passed the mechanical checks",
    "misidentified": "reply opened as another reviewer (fix b)",
    "stale_run": "reply does not belong to the current run",
    "truncated": "reply did not finish (fix c)",
    "gate1_refused": "predictions changed after fire",
    "gate1_unverifiable": "predictions present, verification not built",


}


def run(round_dir, g: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    round_dir = Path(round_dir)
    g = g or gate1.run(round_dir)
    td, held_dir = round_dir / "to_danny", round_dir / "held"
    delivered = [i for i in g["items"] if i["decision"] == "deliver"]
    held = [i for i in g["items"] if i["decision"] == "hold"]
    log = []
    for i in g["items"]:
        reason = ", ".join(i["reasons"]) if i["reasons"] else "deliver"
        rule = "; ".join(RULES.get(r, r) for r in i["reasons"]) or RULES["deliver"]
        log.append({"ts": hs.now_utc(), "run_id": i["run_id"], "item_id": i["item_id"], "model": i["model"],
                    "decision": i["decision"], "reason": reason, "rule": rule, "flags": i["flags"]})
    for i in held:
        gate1.write_new(held_dir / f"{i['item_id']}.json", json.dumps(i, indent=2) + "\n")
    md = ["# Packet", "", f"Gate 1: {g['summary_line']}", "", f"Predictions: {g['predictions']}", "",
          "## Delivered", ""]
    md += [f"- `{i['file']}` ({i['stage']})" + (f" · flags: {', '.join(i['flags'])}" if i["flags"] else "")
           for i in delivered] or ["- none"]
    md += ["", "## Held (in held/)", ""]
    md += [f"- `{i['item_id']}`: {', '.join(i['reasons'])}" + ("" if i.get("landed", True) else " (no reply landed)")
           for i in held] or ["- none"]
    md += ["", "Nothing in this folder has been sent anywhere."]
    gate1.write_new(td / "packet.md", "\n".join(md) + "\n")
    gate1.write_new(td / "gaps.jsonl", "".join(json.dumps(x) + "\n" for x in g["gaps"]))
    with open(round_dir / "handoff_log.jsonl", "a") as fh:
        for rec in log:
            fh.write(json.dumps(rec) + "\n")
    return {"delivered": len(delivered), "held": len(held)}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import argparse
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Hand-off (files only)")
    ap.add_argument("--round-dir", required=True)
